title: Multiple-Hypothesis and Description-Length Scoring
negative_results: a significance claim made without a multiplicity correction is refused (refuse_uncorrected_multiplicity)
a raw p-value that looks significant (p=0.002) does not survive a Bonferroni correction over a large search space; the best raw match becomes a look-everywhere artefact with no surviving explanation
negative or non-finite description-length bits, and an out-of-range p-value, are refused
routing Benjamini-Hochberg through the single-value correct_pvalue is refused; an empty candidate set is refused

claims.statement: A candidate is scored by minimum description length (codec_bits + param_bits + residual_bits); the compact mapping that survives the multiple-comparison correction is the best explanation even though an ornate codec has the smaller raw residual (POWER: best_raw != best_explanation).

The raw p-value of a match is corrected for the number of hypotheses searched via Bonferroni, Sidak, or Benjamini-Hochberg over the search space; the best raw match is not the best explanation once complexity and multiplicity are charged.

privacy_check: CLEAN - illustrative bit counts and p-values only, no inputs, no private data, no real coordinates
